Kohleria 'Coccinea'

Produces pollen?Yes

Notes

A beautiful, yet slightly more finicky Kohleria to grow than most other varieties. The plant tends to be a poor rhizome producer, at least in my experience.

Unknown origin. It could be synonymous with Kohleria 'Selby', but I haven't grown these clones side by side personally.

The name has the ring of a scientific species name, but Kohleria coccinea is not a valid scientific name. This plant should have hybrid origin. To me it looks like it has a lot of Kohleria hirsuta (Kohleria eriantha) influence.

I do not grow this plant as of 2026.
